description:
WHO WE ARE

Odyssey https://odyssey.ml is an AI lab pioneering general world models: causal, multimodal systems that learn to predict and interact with the world over long horizons. This foundational technology promises to revolutionize robotics, science, healthcare, education, gaming, defense, and beyond.

Odyssey’s founders previously pioneered the most complex application of physical AI: self-driving cars. They’ve now brought together a world-class research team from DeepMind, Tesla, Waymo, Meta, Apple, and Wayve, who have made significant contributions to language models (DeepMind Gemini), video models (DeepMind Veo), world models (Wayve GAIA), and autonomous systems (Tesla FSD).

Odyssey has raised significant venture capital from GV, Amazon, AMD, EQT, NVIDIA, Natural Capital, In-Q-Tel, Elad Gil, Jeff Dean, Guillermo Rauch, Garry Tan, Kyle Vogt, and researchers from OpenAI, DeepMind, MSL, Recursive, and Thinking Machines.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're a product engineer who loves turning frontier research into products robotics and autonomy teams can use. You prototype fast: you can take a new model capability, build something a customer can try within days, and learn from what happens. You think across the stack, from the model API to the interface a customer touches, and you know when a prototype has earned the work to make it production-ready. You're drawn to the ambiguity of building products in a space that barely exists yet.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Prototype new applications on top of our models, get them in front of customers quickly, and iterate on what you learn.

 - Take the prototypes that work and turn them into production products: opinionated workflows for specific physical AI use cases.

 - Work alongside forward-deployed engineers and customers to turn what we learn in deployments into product.

 - Partner with research to get new model capabilities into customers' hands as soon as they're ready.

 - Build on our developer platform and push it to get better: you're its most demanding user.

 - Give structured, hands-on feedback on our models and products: where they shine, where they break, and what we should build next.

 - Work closely with research, product, and leadership, often in person, stepping into different efforts as priorities shift.
   
    


WHO YOU ARE

 - Fast and scrappy when exploring, rigorous when shipping. You know which mode a problem calls for.

 - A strong full-stack engineer, comfortable across both frontend and backend systems. You have solid Python for working with ML code; you've shipped production services; and you can build the interface a customer needs to try what you've made. 

 - Experienced building products on top of modern AI systems. You've worked in or close to deep ML environments. Experience with robotics, simulation, or real-time systems is a plus.

 - Product-minded. You make good calls on what to build and what to skip, and you care about how the product feels to the people using it, not just whether it runs.

 - Hands-on and low-ego. You enjoy getting stuck into whatever needs doing.

 - A clear communicator who can work directly with researchers, product, leadership, and customers.

 - Excited by world models and physical AI (robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones), and comfortable building where the category is still being defined.
   
    

Our staff is expected to be in office at least three times a week. A lot of our progress comes from working through problems together, and we want you in the room for that.
